subject: Safety-net triage: Q3 pipe coverage & last-call commit for HeliosPay
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@heliospay.com>
Cc: procurement@heliospay.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Safety-net triage: Q3 pipe coverage & last-call commit for HeliosPay

Team / Elaine —

Quick note: finance ran a mid-week coverage check and HelioSPay is showing a ~$750k shortfall against our Q3 ARR target if the current stage mix holds. I attached a coverage snapshot with rollups and scenario buckets.

As a safety-net triage, I need the following by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-23):
- Stage owners: confirm whether each active opp in the attached sheet should be counted as COMMIT, AT-RISK, or REMOVE. Add a one-line reason for AT-RISK entries.
- Marissa: for the three deals >$150k, confirm pricing/terms alignment or flag blockers.
- Rishi: quick validation on probability bump assumptions (are we comfortable moving any late-stage opps to commit?).
- Laura: finance needs final close dates for any COMMITs that will land in June vs July.

Elaine — if HelioSPay plans to accelerate procurement, let us know the new timeline so we can adjust routing.

Attachments: coverage_snapshot_Q3.xlsx (xlsx, 65KB); HelioSPay_MUTA_v2.pdf (24KB)

Thanks — this is a hard cut: we either find coverage or we need to surface the gap to execs Friday.

Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Elaine Park <elaine@heliospay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliospay.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Safety-net triage: Q3 pipe coverage & last-call commit for HeliosPay

Jonas — thanks for the heads up and for the snapshot. We did a quick internal check and can confirm: the two largest opps (HSP-430 and HSP-411) are still on track to close this quarter from a purchasing perspective, but our legal team still needs to clear a single data residency clause. Procurement is looped here.

A couple of clarifications:
- The dates in your sheet show "expected close" for HSP-430 as 6/28 — can you confirm which contract version you're planning to send? We saw a note about MUTA_v2 in the attachment.
- For HSP-399 (the $180k opportunity), we now have an internal budget question — if you can mark it AT-RISK and include the short reason, that will help speed procurement.

We can try to accelerate legal review if you share the final MUTA_v2 with the redlined clause highlighted.

Best,
Elaine Park
VP, IT & Procurement
HelioSPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@heliospay.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:01:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Safety-net triage: Q3 pipe coverage & last-call commit for HeliosPay

Jonas / team — I updated the attached sheet with my notes (see column "triage_status"). Summary: 

• HSP-430 ($420k) — MOVE TO COMMIT. Sales and customer aligned. Waiting on legal data-residency clause; Elaine indicated procurement can help accelerate. Close date: 2027-06-28 (owner: Marissa).
• HSP-411 ($210k) — KEEP AS COMMIT. Technical eval finished; PM confirmed integration window. Close date: 2027-06-30 (owner: Marissa).
• HSP-399 ($180k) — MARKED AT-RISK: internal budget questions; I recommend outreach from AE with a refreshed ROI one-pager. (owner: Rishi follow up).
• HSP-377 ($65k) — REMOVE from commit: AE lost buyer momentum after org reorg.

Net impact on coverage: with the two COMMITs confirmed we recover ~$630k out of the $750k shortfall, leaving a residual gap of ~ $120k. I'm pushing the AE on HSP-399 today.

Quick asks:
- Rishi — can you run a probability check and confirm if we can flip any pipeline into short-term commit?
- Laura — finance needs to confirm whether we can recognize any ARR for late June closes; if not, we may need to carry to July.

Elaine — I've attached a redline summary that highlights the clause Jon asked about. If procurement can give an ETA on legal review, that will be the gating item.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE (MidMarket)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Cc: procurement@heliospay.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safety-net triage: Q3 pipe coverage & last-call commit for HeliosPay — ACTION SUMMARY

Thanks all — concise action summary and owners (we'll present to finance at 14:00 PT if anything changes):

1) Marissa — finalize MUTA_v2 send to procurement with the highlighted residency clause (deadline: today EOD 6/23). Confirm again when sent.
2) Rishi — run quick probability sanity and decide if HSP-399 can be pushed to COMMIT with a refreshed ROI by EOD 6/23. If not, mark as REMOVE.
3) Laura — confirm revenue recognition possibility for late-June closes by 12:00 PT today; if June is not feasible, flag the carry into July so forecast reflects accurately.
4) Elaine / procurement — estimate legal review ETA; if you can give a hard date we will lock the commit.

If we land HSP-430 + HSP-411 as COMMIT this week we close ~630k of the gap; remaining ~120k we treat as contingent until next-week clean-up. If anything shifts, escalate to me and I will loop finance and the CRO.

I'll consolidate final numbers and send the updated coverage table to execs at 15:00 PT if we have firm answers.

Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
